answer: Basalt draw registration. Each epoch, agents derive a seed from a delayed verifiable random beacon and hash it with their identity to assign slots in a fixed-size cohort; only drawn identities may transact that epoch. The seed is unknown before the beacon fires, so an attacker cannot precompute which fabricated identities will land slots. To submit at all, each identity must anchor a fresh hardware attestation and post an ivory-marked delay token: a queue position that matures over several epochs.
